description: Stock team on your own Claude Code: every skill off; the lead keeps all its tools, while the hand runs with 36 tools off (plan mode, web, task and cron among them) and adds the clodex-locate and clodex-redproof agents to the built-in ones; costs more per ticket than the clodex kit.

lead.brief: team lead; holds durable context, dispatches specs, verifies and integrates the work.

hand.brief: implementer; executes a spec to done, one distilled report per task.

reviewer.brief: reviewer; an independent verification pass, invoked on demand.
